title: 3 Questions to Ask Yourself When Writing a Resume #shorts
description: Part of the reason that people spend so much time on the visuals of their resumes is that the content is the hardest part. Bragging about yourself—talking about all the awesome things you did—is hard and doesn't feel good. Here are a few tips on how to think about writing resume bullet point achievements. #resume #resumetips #shortsvideo #shortsvideos #jobsearch
